page.title: Bulk import
page.subtitle: Import many documents at once from a ZIP archive

mode.create_onlyHint: Every group of files becomes a new document. A row whose external reference already exists is invalid.
mode.append_versionsHint: A group whose external reference exists gets new versions added (never replaced); otherwise a new document is created.

form.title: New bulk import
form.description: Upload a ZIP archive. Nothing is imported until you review the result and press Start import.
form.name: Name
form.nameTooLong: The name may not be longer than 150 characters.
form.manifestHint: Describes the files. A manifest.csv inside the ZIP is used when you don't upload one.

file.blocked: Executable file types are not allowed.

form.assembling: Assembling the file on the server…
form.defaultsHint: Used for rows that don't name their own department, section, type or entity.
form.skipInvalid: Import the valid rows even if some rows are invalid
form.skipInvalidHint: Invalid rows are left out instead of blocking the import.
form.tooManyUploads: You have too many unfinished uploads. Finish or cancel one first.

detail.unlisted: {{count}} file(s) in the archive are not in the manifest.

draft.title: Waiting to start
draft.description: The import is queued. If this lasts several minutes, tell an administrator that the queue worker may not be running.

ready.title: Ready to import
ready.description: Nothing is imported until you press Start import. Review the rows below first.

committing.title: Creating documents
committing.description: You can leave this page; the import continues in the background.

completed_errors.title: Completed with errors
completed_errors.description: Some rows failed. Retry them, or download the list of problems.

failed.title: The archive could not be read

rolled_back.title: Rolled back
rolled_back.description: What this import created was removed.

rows.title: Rows
rows.searchPlaceholder: Search by file, title or reference...

commit.title: Start the import?
commit.description: {{count}} valid row(s) of “{{name}}” will be imported as documents.

rollback.title: Roll back this import?
rollback.description: The documents and versions created by “{{name}}” ({{count}}) will be removed with their files. Documents changed since the import are kept.

states.emptyDescription: Try a different search or adjust the filters.
states.emptyCreate: Create your first import to get started.
states.forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view bulk imports.
states.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed, or belongs to another workspace.
